title: Smart contribution
subtitle: Tell us how much you are investing and see where to put it to bring your portfolio closer to the target, without selling anything (selling triggers tax).
empty: Enter an amount to see the suggestion.

noAssets.message: No holdings in this class. Add one, or add a holding with zero quantity and give it a target.

emptyPortfolio.message: Add holdings to direct this amount

note.title: How the math works
note.calculation: The math: after the contribution, your net worth reaches {{total}}. Each class below its target receives the difference up to the target; if the money does not cover everything, it is split in proportion to what is missing. Inside a class, the same rule applies between holdings.
note.disclaimer: This is a mathematical suggestion to bring your portfolio closer to its target, without selling anything. It is not investment advice.

targetsNotSet.title: Set your target portfolio first
targetsNotSet.description: To suggest where the contribution goes, Vera needs to know how much you want in each class.

classTargetsNot100.title: The class targets do not add up to 100%
classTargetsNot100.detail: The suggestion uses the targets as they are. Adjust your target portfolio so it reflects what you want.

error.title: We could not calculate the suggestion.
error.rateLimited: Too many simulations in a short time. Wait a moment and try again.

settingsError: We could not load the base currency.
